name: Kettlebell Single-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand tall holding a kettlebell in the hand opposite your standing leg with your weight grounded firmly through your standing foot.
Soften your standing knee slightly and hinge forward at your hips as your free leg extends straight behind you.
Lower the kettlebell smoothly toward the floor with a flat back until your torso approaches parallel and your hamstring stretches.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your standing glute to return upright, then switch sides after completing one leg.
tips: Keep both hip bones level and facing the floor rather than opening your lifted hip sideways.
Pack your loaded shoulder back so the kettlebell hangs straight beneath your shoulder without rounding your back.
